name: Burning Blade clan
summary: Across Durotar and the Barrens, the Burning Blade threatens the young Horde from within. Once renowned for its blademasters, the clan broke under demonic corruption. Now most of its scattered members serve the Shadow Council, while a few honorable blademasters stand with Warchief Thrall.

sections.title: From Clan to Elemental Fury
sections.body:
The Burning Blade once fought beside clans such as the Warsong on Draenor. Its blademasters were famed for deadly skill. After drinking Mannoroth’s blood and crossing the Dark Portal into Azeroth during the First War, the clan’s minds broke into chaos.

By the Second War, it had lost all order and raged like a force of nature. These nomadic fighters charged without regard for survival, so ogres held them back until battle called. Near the Dark Portal, the Alliance battered and routed them.

sections.title: The Threat in Durotar
sections.body: Across Kalimdor, Burning Blade covens trouble newly arrived orcs and Darkspear trolls from their first days in the Valley of Trials. Warlocks dwell in Thunder Ridge and keep a major hideout in Skull Rock, near Orgrimmar’s eastern gates. The cultists gather around dark relics such as the Demon Seed and harvest souls for demonic rites. In Durotar and the Barrens, they threaten the young Horde from within.

sections.title: The Traitor in the Cleft
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade lives in the Cleft of Shadow as a Horde warlock, yet secretly leads the Burning Blade for the Shadow Council. He uses pawns such as the expendable Searing Blade of Ragefire Chasm to preserve the guise of a harmless researcher aiding the Warchief. Thrall has already deduced Neeru’s treachery and watches him closely.

sections.title: A Split Legacy
sections.body: After the Second War, surviving members of the Burning Blade split apart. A disciplined band of blademasters vowed to free their people from demonic enslavement and pledged their swords to Warchief Thrall as his personal honor guard. Many others fell under the Burning Legion and the Shadow Council. Across Kalimdor, they became a hidden cult of warlocks, fel acolytes, and conspirators.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade clan?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade began as an orcish clan from Draenor, renowned for its blademasters. Bloodlust consumed the clan during the First and Second Wars. Now most who bear its name belong to a demon-worshiping cult serving the Shadow Council across Kalimdor, though a few reformed blademasters serve Thrall’s Horde.

faq.q: Who actually leads the Burning Blade?
aliases: who is the leader of burning blade
faq.answer: The Shadow Council directs the Burning Blade, whose covens in Durotar and the Barrens are led by warlocks and demon-summoners. Their true master remains hidden, though the trail leads close to Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why are they attacking new orcs in the Valley of Trials?
aliases: why are cultists in valley of trials
faq.answer: The Burning Blade keeps a coven in the northern caves of the Valley of Trials to disrupt young orcs and trolls as they undergo their rites of passage. Its familiars and dark medallions spread fel corruption in the heart of Horde lands.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Burning Blade and Searing Blade?
aliases: difference between burning and searing blade
faq.answer: The Searing Blade is a smaller sect deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. The Burning Blade is the broader cult across Durotar and the Barrens. The chasm holds clues to who directs the sect.

faq.q: Are all Burning Blade members demon-worshiping cultists?
faq.answer: No. Though the cult holds most of the clan’s scattered members, proud blademasters broke away by the Third War. They vowed to free their people from demonic enslavement and now serve in the New Horde as Thrall’s personal honor guard.

angles.text: The Burning Blade is a lingering sign of the Horde’s corrupt demonic past, threatening Durotar and the Barrens from within.
The Burning Blade shows the danger of demonic enslavement, which drives Horde warlocks to conceal their studies and endure suspicion.
The clan’s fall recalls the blood curse, while its honor-bound blademasters seek atonement in service to Thrall.
